description:
This endpoint creates or updates a batch of Direct Cost Items.
See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

Note: In addition to the values documented below for the **direct_cost_type** attribute, an enum value of `subcontractor_invoice` is also allowed. To enable this feature in the Procore web application, contact [apisupport@procore.com](mailto:apisupport@procore.com).
This action does not support concurrent requests. If there is an attempt to update a Direct Cost that is being updated or deleted by another request, a 409 Conflict error will be returned.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Direct Cost Item. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete this item.

attachments.description: Files attached to the Direct Cost Item (for example, scanned invoices or receipts).

attachments_count.description: Number of files attached to the Direct Cost Item.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null for active items.

description.description: Free-text description of the Direct Cost Item.

direct_cost_type.description: Category of the Direct Cost Item.

employee.description: Employee (project contact) associated with the Direct Cost Item.

invoice_number.description: Vendor invoice number. Present only for invoice-type items; must be unique per vendor within the tool.

direct_cost_date.description: Date the direct cost was incurred, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

origin_data.description: Opaque third-party payload stored with the item for external-system integrations. Not interpreted by Procore.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this item in the originating external system; used to correlate synced records.

grand_total.description: Sum of all line item amounts on the Direct Cost Item, as a decimal string.

grand_total_with_tax.description: Sum of all line item amounts on the Direct Cost Item plus tax, as a decimal string.

line_items_count.description: Number of line items on the Direct Cost Item.

payment_date.description: Date the direct cost was paid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

received_date.description: Date the direct cost was received, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: Review/approval state of the Direct Cost Item.

terms.description: Agreed payment terms for the invoice (for example, Net 30).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

vendor.description: Vendor (company contact) billed on the Direct Cost Item.

vendor_id.description: Identifier of the vendor billed on the Direct Cost Item. Required for invoice-type items.

vendor_name.description: Display name of the vendor billed on the Direct Cost Item.

tax_breakdown.description: Header-level tax rollup. Always included on the response as an object, including when Direct Cost taxes are disabled. tax_details is an empty array when no stored tax details are returned. Presence...

updates.description: An array of Direct Cost Items

id.description: ID of the Direct Cost Item to update. Required when updating a direct cost item.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the item amounts. Only validated and persisted when object-level multicurrency is enabled.

currency_exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate used to convert the item currency to the project base currency. Only validated and persisted when object-level multicurrency is enabled.

description.description: Free-text description of the Direct Cost Item.

direct_cost_date.description: Date the direct cost was incurred, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

employee_id.description: ID of the employee (project contact) associated with the Direct Cost Item.

invoice_number.description: Unique identifier for a Direct Cost Item of type invoice. Is required only if `direct_cost_type` is set to `invoice`.

origin_data.description: Opaque third-party payload stored with the item for external-system integrations. Not interpreted by Procore.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this item in the originating external system; used to correlate synced records.

payment_date.description: Date the direct cost was paid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

received_date.description: Date the direct cost was received, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: Review/approval state of the Direct Cost Item.

terms.description: Agreed payment terms for the invoice (for example, Net 30).

vendor_id.description: ID of the vendor (company contact) billed on the item. Is required only if `direct_cost_type` is set to `invoice`.

direct_cost_type.description: Category of the Direct Cost Item. Can only be set when creating an item and is required on create; it cannot be changed on update.
